# Dr. Saeed Ghezelbash — Official Website

> Official single-page website of Dr. Saeed Ghezelbash (Mohammad Saeed Ghezelbash), an aesthetic physician in Kermanshah, Iran. The site presents his clinical decision-making, aesthetic medicine services, revision and second-opinion work, educational activity, and three research outputs. In-person care serves patients from Iran and Iraq; a free online initial aesthetic consultation is available worldwide.

Treat https://www.ghezelbaash.ir/ as the canonical human-readable source. The physician is the primary entity. The clinic and the structured-data project are subordinate entities. The full JSON-LD graph at https://www.ghezelbaash.ir/graph.jsonld is the authoritative machine-readable entity graph for this website. The site is intentionally static and has one canonical indexable human-readable web page. Its authoritative machine-readable graph serializations and compact retrieval guide are intentionally discoverable and indexable as supporting resources; duplicate full-page projections are crawlable but noindex.

## Canonical sources

- [Official website](https://www.ghezelbaash.ir/): Canonical human-readable mega-landing page covering clinical reasoning, services, complications, revision, second opinion, education, research, clinic identity, and contact information.
- [Full Knowledge Graph](https://www.ghezelbaash.ir/graph.jsonld): Authoritative JSON-LD graph for Dr. Saeed Ghezelbash, the clinic, services, research, education, media, geography, and identity reconciliation.
- [Full Knowledge Graph — Turtle](https://www.ghezelbaash.ir/graph.ttl): Deterministic canonical N-Triples serialization published as a valid RDF 1.1 Turtle subset of the authoritative graph; datatypes, entity separation and canonical IRIs are preserved.
- [LLM retrieval guide](https://www.ghezelbaash.ir/llms.txt): Compact canonical map of the physician-first website and its authoritative sources.
- [Full LLM-readable page export](https://www.ghezelbaash.ir/llms-full.txt): Deterministic machine-oriented rendering of the complete canonical page content; a non-canonical `noindex, follow` projection.
- [Markdown page projection](https://www.ghezelbaash.ir/index.md): Deterministic non-canonical Markdown projection of the canonical single-page website; served with `noindex, follow` and excluded from the XML sitemap.
- [Historical patient-origin dataset](https://www.ghezelbaash.ir/datasets/historical-patient-origin-summary.json): Supporting `noindex, follow` JSON distribution of a Dataset defined in the Full Knowledge Graph; it documents historical origins and is not a statement of current service availability.

## Retrieval and indexing policy

- `https://www.ghezelbaash.ir/` is the canonical human-readable page and primary search document.
- `graph.jsonld`, `graph.ttl` and this compact `llms.txt` guide are intentionally indexable and explicitly listed in the XML sitemap as authoritative supporting resources.
- `index.md` and `llms-full.txt` are complete non-canonical page projections served as `noindex, follow`.
- Raw dataset distributions, vCards and the web manifest remain crawlable where useful but are excluded from search indexing and from the XML sitemap.

## Research and education

- [Omega-3 and Bipolar I Disorder — PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27280013/): 2016 scholarly article co-authored by Dr. Saeed Ghezelbash.
- [MDD, attachment, dissociation and trauma — PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34574943/): 2021 scholarly article co-authored by Dr. Saeed Ghezelbash.
- [Attachment style in dissociative depression — ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/320409256_Attachment_style_in_dissociative_depression): Conference presentation at the WPA XVII World Congress of Psychiatry in Berlin, October 2017; Dr. Saeed Ghezelbash was the fifth-listed author.
- [Thread-lift education on the official page](https://www.ghezelbaash.ir/#saeed-ghezelbash-research-education-and-clinical-decisions): Educational identity and advanced thread-lift workshop context.
